title: ÆTHER album Kaattu Thee, song 1: Introduction instrumental (1 min test)
story: Rudra, a Chennai street boy nobody took seriously, walks back into his area and the street lights up. Mass hero entry theme.

brief.notes: Jithesh 13:04 on the sung test: 'Destroying the music. Really bad'. He chose 'Instrumental first' (13:06): no AI singing; the melody hook has to carry the song. Kept musical and clean, not a wall of noise: one lead melody, clear space, then the big moment.

prompt: A modern Tamil film mass hero-entry theme, instrumental, new-generation Kollywood style. Built around ONE strong, catchy, singable lead melody in a minor key with an Indian flavour, played first on a bright reedy nadaswaram-like synth lead, then doubled by a whistle and heroic brass. The melody is simple, repeats often and is easy to hum after one listen. Clean, punchy, musical production with space, not noisy: tight parai and thappu kuthu drums locked with a modern trap beat and deep 808 bass, a gang 'hey' shout only on the big beats. 124 BPM. Starts with a quiet tense pulse and the melody alone on a single instrument, builds with a riser, a short silence, then a huge drop around 18 seconds where the drums, bass and brass carry the full melody. A second, bigger statement of the melody with strings and brass, ends on one hard hit.
